name: Dither Veil
description: WebGL dithered image panel where the picture shows as a retro dithered duotone and a pointer-following brush reveals the original photo through a dithered edge, with click shockwaves.
contents: Single container div filled by a WebGL canvas rendering one image
Dithered version of the image with the original photo revealed under the pointer
behavior: Intro wipe dissolves the dithered image in from the center on load
Pointer brush with smooth lag reveals the original photo, and the reveal fades out after the pointer leaves
Click or tap emits a ring shockwave reveal, up to 4 at once, lasting 1.2 seconds
Optional autonomous wandering reveal when the pointer is outside
Rendering pauses when offscreen or idle and resumes on interaction or prop change
Wander is disabled when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Image source and fit mode (contain or cover)
Dither pattern, pixel size, tone levels and duotone or rgb palette
Ink, paper and rim colors, contrast and brightness
Reveal radius, edge softness, trail linger time, rim width and reverse mode
Autonomous wander and click shockwave toggles
Size and placement through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change shockwave duration or maximum simultaneous shockwaves
Change how long the reveal holds its strength or the intro duration
Add another Floyd-style error diffusion kernel

fixed: Requires WebGL2 and the ogl package
Needs a parent with a defined height since the container is w-full h-full
Image is loaded with crossOrigin anonymous, so the host must allow CORS
Image change restarts the whole WebGL setup, other props update live
Error diffusion patterns (floyd, atkinson) are computed on the CPU per resize or setting change, which is heavy on very large panels with small pixelSize
Reveal depends on pointer events, touch devices only get tap shockwaves and the touch-pan-y class keeps vertical scrolling
Unknown pattern values fall back to bayer
